finding: A new Clay Identity Registry contract makes FRANK the architecture/family name and ClayID the immutable canonical identity of each individual synthetic entity. Registry entries are append-only; copies mint a new ClayID before first Pulse; each ClayID owns an independent authoritative current-state namespace; same-lineage restore may retain identity only with a continuity receipt. The subsequent work event queues implementation and tests but does not prove that the registry/copy gate is implemented or passing.
provenance_boundary: The contract and the work event share one owner-directed architecture lineage and are not independent replication. A READY work event is not execution evidence.
